state.message: Hi there, I run a small design studio and would love to talk about featuring your app in our newsletter. We reach about 8,000 product designers. Who is the right person to talk to about a partnership?

team.instructions: Which support team should handle state.message?

criteria.billing: Invoices, charges, refunds and plan changes for an existing customer
criteria.access: Signing in, passwords, two-factor codes and team permissions
criteria.product: Bugs, errors and how-to questions about using the app
criteria.other: Anything that is not a support request for these teams: sales, partnerships, press, job applications, spam
